ambiguity.note: Both the no-fee and no-account conditions are explicit.

evidence.excerpt: The city archive shall provide free online access to final meeting minutes.
Documents must remain downloadable without an account.

annotations.rationale: The passage expressly removes both the price and account barriers to public access.

ambiguity.note: The final-stage date is explicit, but delivery depends on later funding approval.

evidence.excerpt: The department will publish a pilot register by 30 June 2031.
A complete register is scheduled for 31 December 2031, subject to approved funding.

annotations.rationale: The text dates both a pilot stage and a complete stage, while making the latter conditional.

ambiguity.note: The reviewer, review object, frequency, and reporting duty are all stated.

evidence.excerpt: An external reviewer selected by the civic panel shall audit a sample of decisions each year.
The reviewer shall publish a summary that names no individual applicants.

annotations.rationale: An external reviewer must inspect decisions annually and publish a privacy-preserving summary.
